title: Utility Line Protection Plans: Commissioning Contribution on Whole Water and Sewer Line Replacement
content:
# Commissioning Contribution on Whole Water and Sewer Line Replacement

Code-compliance schedule, Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans.

## Rule

Exterior commissioning contribution: on a line that calls for whole-line work, a water service line adds the water commissioning contribution for the pressure test, flushing and disinfection a new water service needs before it is put into use, and a sewer lateral adds the sewer commissioning contribution for the acceptance camera inspection of the finished lateral; every other request adds no commissioning contribution. The exterior commissioning contribution is paid on top of the occurrence cap, and only for permanent exterior work whose contractor quote is above the exterior permanent-work payment. For the acceptance camera inspection of a sewer lateral replaced whole this policy pays the sewer commissioning contribution on top of the occurrence cap, and only for that inspection; every other camera inspection remains under the base rule that it is paid inside the occurrence cap.

An exterior line calls for whole-line work when the plan replaces whole lines after repeat breaks, which is when its full replacement break count is above zero, and the most recent completed repair on the same line was completed no more than the plan's replacement lookback days before the request date.

## Plan figures that decide whole-line work

| Plan | Full-replacement break count | Replacement lookback |
|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Exterior Water Service Line Plan | 2 | 730 days |
| Bridgewell Exterior Electrical Line Plan | 2 | 730 days |
| Bridgewell Exterior Sewer and Septic Line Plan | 2 | 730 days |
| Bridgewell Interior Plumbing and Drainage Plan | 0 | 0 days |
| Bridgewell Water and Sewer Line Bundle | 2 | 730 days |
| Bridgewell Total Home Lines Plan | 2 | 730 days |

## Contributions

| Calls for whole-line work | Line on the request | Commissioning contribution |
|---|---|---|
| yes | exterior water service line | $175.00 (water) |
| yes | sewer lateral | $225.00 (sewer) |
| yes | septic line, electrical service line or gas service line | none |
| no | any | none |

## Boundary cases

Most recent completed repair on the same line completed 730 days before the request date: whole-line work, so a water service line adds $175.00. Completed 731 days before, or no completed repair on record: none.
